lines.text: Many learners say: How to say this in English?
Better: How do you say this in English?
How do you! How do you say this in English?

data.wrong: How to say this in English?
data.right: How do you say this in English?

native.tip: 中文“这个用英语怎么说”很短，直译成 How to say 就不完整了。英语的问句要有主语和 do：How do you say。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “How to say this in English?”😅 中文的“怎么说”不能直译，要补上 do you：“How do you say this in English?”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“How do you say this in English?”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.hook: How to say? Add do you!
en.tip: Chinese can ask this in a few words, but English needs the full question: how do you say.
en.caption: Do you say “How to say this in English?” 😅 The full question needs do you: “How do you say this in English?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
